decks.notes: The deck is focused on assembling a variety of creatures with unique abilities that can be searched for and put into play using Green Sun's Zenith. By utilizing creatures like Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies, the deck can generate infinite mana, while cards like Quillspike and Walking Ballista provide a win condition. The deck also includes tools for card advantage and recursion, such as Eternal Witness and Duskwatch Recruiter. With Leyline of Abundance and Tyvar, the Pummeler providing additional support, the deck aims to create a powerful board state and overwhelm opponents with its combo potential.

The main principle of this deck is to generate a large amount of mana quickly using cards like Ruby Medallion, Desperate Ritual, and Pyretic Ritual, in order to cast powerful spells like Ral, Monsoon Mage and Grapeshot. The deck also utilizes card draw and manipulation with cards like Manamorphose and Past in Flames to ensure consistency in executing its combo. It seeks to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of spells and synergies to quickly take control of the game and secure a victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting and controlling the opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. With a mix of efficient removal like Fatal Push and versatile counterspells like Counterspell and Force of Negation, the deck aims to control the game until it can establish a powerful win condition like Murktide Regent or Kaito, Bane of Nightmares. By denying the opponent resources and threats, the deck seeks to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a battle of attrition.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on utilizing a mix of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal to control the board and outvalue the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation, while also efficiently removing threats with Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and versatility, while finishers like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares can quickly close out the game. The deck's versatility and adaptability make it well-suited for handling a variety of threats and strategies in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on aggressive creature plays while utilizing flicker effects to gain additional value from entering the battlefield effects and protect key creatures. The deck includes a mix of powerful creatures with strong abilities, disruption spells to control the opponent's hand, and lands that support the color requirements of the cards. By combining aggression with blink effects, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents while maintaining flexibility and resilience through its blinking strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with the ability to repeatedly blink creatures for additional value. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, you can continually trigger enter-the-battlefield effects of creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Quantum Riddler. This strategy disrupts your opponent's game plan while also building up your own board presence. Additionally, cards like Solitude and Fatal Push provide removal options to keep your opponent's threats at bay. With a mix of efficient creatures and disruption spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly while maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures with cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. The goal is to cheat large threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Griselbrand into play early in the game. Other cards like Psychic Frog and Quantum Riddler help control the opponent's board, while Faithful Mending and Thoughtseize provide card advantage and disruption. The deck also includes a few counterspells like Force of Negation to protect its combo pieces. Overall, this deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures.

The deck focuses on generating mana quickly with cards like Ruby Medallion and rituals, while using Ral, Monsoon Mage to generate additional mana and deal damage to the opponent. The deck also utilizes spells like Hex Magic and Reckless Impulse to dig for combo pieces, along with Past in Flames to recycle spells from the graveyard. The goal is to ultimately cast Grapeshot to deal lethal damage to the opponent in one turn. The deck runs a number of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent mana fixing.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures with abilities that trigger upon entering the battlefield or leaving it. It aims to repeatedly "blink" these creatures to generate value and disrupt the opponent's gameplan. By using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, alongside powerful threats like Overlord of the Balemurk and Solitude, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent. Key cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help control the board while Teferi, Time Raveler provides support and protection. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize consistency.

This deck focuses on using creatures with various abilities to assemble powerful combos that generate massive amounts of mana and overwhelm opponents. By using cards like Devoted Druid, Leyline of Abundance, and Green Sun's Zenith to tutor for key pieces, the deck can quickly ramp up and put out huge threats like Craterhoof Behemoth. With support from cards like Nature's Rhythm and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler, the deck can create explosive turns and close out games quickly. The toolbox of creatures allows for flexibility in adapting to different matchups and situations.

The deck focuses on assembling a diverse toolbox of creatures to generate mana and combo off with powerful finishers like Craterhoof Behemoth and Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu. With cards like Devoted Druid, Leyline of Abundance, and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler, the deck can ramp up quickly and overwhelm the opponent with explosive plays. The inclusion of Green Sun's Zenith and Nature's Rhythm allows for flexible creature tutoring and untapping shenanigans. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outcombo the opponent in a fast-paced Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck relies on control through graveyard manipulation and removal spells to outvalue and outlast the opponent. By utilizing cards like Necrodominance and Orcish Bowmasters to control the board, along with Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's plans, the deck aims to maintain a grip on the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Soul Spike. The inclusion of cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Force of Despair further solidify its control strategy, making it difficult for the opponent to mount a successful offense.

This deck aims to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate. It also utilizes cards like Psychic Frog and Quantum Riddler to control the game by disrupting the opponent's strategy. The deck is designed to be resilient with cards like Faithful Mending and Solitude to protect the combo pieces. Additionally, cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation help to deal with threats from the opponent. The mana base is constructed to support the combo pieces while still providing enough colored mana sources for the deck to function smoothly.

This deck focuses on using instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to bring powerful creatures like Griselbrand into play quickly. By combining these spells with cards like Solitude and Psychic Frog, the deck aims to disrupt opponents while creating a strong board presence. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation allows for additional disruption and protection. The deck's mana base includes a variety of lands to ensure consistent colors for casting spells, while also including utility lands like Hedge Maze and Undercity Sewers for added versatility.

This deck focuses on quickly getting creatures into the graveyard and then reanimating them for powerful and unexpected plays. By utilizing cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate, along with powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Griselbrand, the deck can create explosive combos that can quickly overwhelm opponents. Additionally, cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation help to control the game and protect key pieces of the combo. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

This Merfolk deck focuses on quickly building up a board of creatures with powerful tribal synergy. By utilizing Lords like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, along with disruptive cards like Tishana's Tidebinder and Harbinger of the Seas, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. Aether Vial allows for efficient creature deployment, while disruption in the form of counterspells like Force of Negation and Flare of Denial helps protect the board. Mutavault and Cavern of Souls provide additional utility and mana fixing for the deck's game plan.
